# USD

49 tools for USD stages, prims, attributes, variants, references and layers.

Back to the [index](README.md).

## `add_usd_internal_reference`

*Additive.*

Add an internal reference composition arc (references another prim inside the SAME stage; no asset_path needed).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under. |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Prim that owns the reference (the consumer). |
| `target_prim_path` | string | yes | Prim inside the same stage to reference. |
| `position` | string | no | List position (same vocabulary as add_usd_reference). Default "BackOfPrependList". |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, prim_path: string, target_prim_path: string, added: bool, position: string, errors: [string]? }`

## `add_usd_payload`

*Additive.*

Add a payload composition arc to a prim (load-on-demand; payloads are NOT loaded by the stage unless an explicit Load rule says so). Inverse: clear_usd_payloads (one payload with asset_path).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under. |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Prim that owns the payload. |
| `asset_path` | string | yes | Identifier of the layer containing the payload. |
| `prim_path_for_target` | string | no | Prim inside the referenced layer to import. Empty (default) means '/'. |
| `position` | string | no | List position (same vocabulary as add_usd_reference). Default "BackOfPrependList". |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, prim_path: string, asset_path: string, added: bool, position: string, errors: [string]? }`

## `add_usd_reference`

*Additive.*

Add an external reference composition arc to a prim (asset_path -> target prim, optionally re-targeted by prim_path_for_target).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under. |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Prim that owns the reference (target of the composition op on the consumer side). |
| `asset_path` | string | yes | Identifier of the layer to reference (absolute file path or USD-style relative identifier). |
| `prim_path_for_target` | string | no | Prim inside the referenced layer to import. Empty (default) means the referenced layer's pseudo-root '/'. The default matches the common "import the whole layer" use case. |
| `position` | string | no | One of "FrontOfPrependList" / "BackOfPrependList" / "FrontOfAppendList" / "BackOfAppendList" (default BackOfPrependList — pxr::'s default for the strongest-anonymous opinion). |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, prim_path: string, asset_path: string, added: bool, position: string, errors: [string]? }`

## `add_usd_variant`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Add a new variant to an existing variant set at the requested list position; idempotent (returns already_existed:true when the variant is already present). Inverse: remove_usd_variant.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | SdfPath of the prim that authors the variant set |
| `variant_set_name` | string | yes | Variant set that will receive the new variant |
| `variant_name` | string | yes | Name of the variant to add |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Stage cache key |
| `position` | string | no | One of FrontOfPrependList / BackOfPrependList / FrontOfAppendList / BackOfAppendList (default BackOfPrependList) |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, variant_set_name: string, variant_name: string, added: bool, already_existed: bool, position: string }`

## `add_usd_variant_set`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Author a new (empty) variant set on a prim at the requested list position; idempotent (returns already_existed:true when the set is already present). Inverse: remove_usd_variant_set.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | SdfPath of the prim that will author the variant set |
| `variant_set_name` | string | yes | Name of the variant set to create |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Stage cache key |
| `position` | string | no | One of FrontOfPrependList / BackOfPrependList / FrontOfAppendList / BackOfAppendList (default BackOfPrependList, matching the USD wrapper default) |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, variant_set_name: string, created: bool, already_existed: bool, position: string }`

## `apply_usd_prim_schema`

*Destructive.*

Apply a USD API schema (e.g. "MaterialBindingAPI") to an existing prim of a registered USD stage, on the current edit target. Checks CanApplyAPI first: a schema that cannot apply returns applied=false with the USD reason in why_not instead of an error. Not saved to disk.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `schema_name` | string | yes | Schema identifier (not the C++ class name), e.g. "MaterialBindingAPI", "GeomModelAPI" |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under by create_usd_stage or open_usd_stage; a stage already in the USD cache also matches by the end of its root layer identifier. |

**Returns:** `{ applied: bool, schema_name: string, why_not?: string }`

## `clear_usd_attribute`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Clear authored values of a USD attribute on a prim of an open stage: with time, only the sample at that time code; without it, the default value and every time sample. Edits the stage in memory; save_usd_stage writes it. Returns present and cleared, present false when the attribute is missing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under by open_usd_stage (default the file basename) or create_usd_stage (default "Untitled"). |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim on that stage, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `attr_name` | string | yes | Name of the attribute to clear, e.g. "size". |
| `time` | number | no | Time code of the single sample to clear (ClearAtTime); omit it to clear the default value and all samples (Clear). |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, attr_name: string, cleared: bool, present: bool, time: number? }`

## `clear_usd_payloads`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Remove the payload arcs of a prim: every payload (UsdPayloads::ClearPayloads), or with asset_path the one payload to that layer and target prim (RemovePayload). Inverse of add_usd_payload, which clear_usd_references does not touch; the edit lands on the stage's current edit target layer, as the add did. Irreversible, like every USD composition edit here (no undo). had_payloads and has_payloads are the prim read before and after (UsdPrim::HasAuthoredPayloads). A stage or prim that does not resolve is an error; a prim with no payload is an honest no-op (cleared=false). Save the layer with save_usd_stage.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under. |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Prim whose payloads should be removed. |
| `asset_path` | string | no | Optional identifier of the payload's layer: only the payload to that layer (and prim_path_for_target) goes. |
| `prim_path_for_target` | string | no | With asset_path, the prim inside that layer the payload targets, as given to add_usd_payload. Empty (default) means '/', as for add_usd_payload. |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, prim_path: string, asset_path?: string, had_payloads: bool, cleared: bool, has_payloads: bool, errors: [string]? }`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Remove every reference from a prim's reference list (irreversible — there is no "undo" in USD composition authoring).

| `prim_path` | string | yes | Prim whose references should be cleared. |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, prim_path: string, cleared: bool, errors: [string]? }`

## `close_usd_stage`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Close a USD stage by its LLM-facing stage_name.  Removes the stage from the LLM-facing UEAgent::UsdRegistry::GStageNameCache AND calls UnrealUSDWrapper::EraseStageFromCache on it — this is the ONLY way to release a memory stage (memory stages are never closed automatically, even on editor shutdown). If stage_name is not in the cache the call returns success with a note rather than an error (idempotent — closing an already-closed stage is a no-op). The 'removed_from_cache' field reports whether the stage was actually present in the UnrealUSDWrapper stage cache at close time.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under via open_usd_stage or create_usd_stage. |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, closed: bool, was_in_cache: bool, removed_from_cache: bool, note: string? }`

## `create_usd_attribute`

*Additive.*

Create an attribute of a given USD type on a prim of an open stage, or return the existing one with created false. Edits the stage in memory; save_usd_stage writes it. Returns name, type_name, cpp_type and created; author its value with set_usd_attribute_value.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under by open_usd_stage (default the file basename) or create_usd_stage (default "Untitled"). |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim on that stage, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `attr_name` | string | yes | Attribute name (e.g. "size", "displayColor") |
| `type_name` | string | yes | USD type name (e.g. "float", "float3", "token", "asset") |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, name: string, type_name: string, cpp_type: string, created: bool }`

## `create_usd_stage`

*Additive.*

Create a new USD stage (either on-disk or in-memory).  When file_path is provided, UnrealUSDWrapper::NewStage(FilePath) creates a root layer file at that path and opens it as a stage. When file_path is omitted or empty, NewStage() (no args) creates a memory-only stage — this is the only way to author a USD stage that is NOT persisted to disk; the only way to clean it up is close_usd_stage. The new stage is always added to the LLM-facing UEAgent::UsdRegistry::GStageNameCache under stage_name (default "Untitled"), so subsequent calls can refer to it by name. The returned identifier is the root layer's USD identifier (real path for on-disk; an anonymous "anon:0x..." handle for memory stages).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file_path` | string | no | Absolute path for the new USD root layer file (.usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz). Omit or empty for a memory-only stage (optional). |
| `stage_name` | string | no | LLM-facing name to register the new stage under (optional, default "Untitled"). |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, file_path: string, memory: bool, identifier: string, real_path: string, dirty: bool, is_valid: bool, errors: [string]? }`

## `create_usd_stage_actor`

*Additive.*

Spawn an AUsdStageActor into the editor's current world (or return the existing one).  Each editor world has at most one AUsdStageActor (USDStage is single-instance per world); when one already exists the tool returns already_existed:true with its current actor_path instead of failing. Spawn uses a uniquely-named FName based on the user-supplied name parameter so re-runs with the same name pick up the existing actor cleanly. Requires a live editor world — honest-gated.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | Desired actor name (default "UsdStageActor"). Used only on first spawn; ignored on subsequent calls that pick up the existing actor. |
| `location` | array | no | World [x, y, z] location for the new actor (optional, default [0, 0, 0]). |
| `rotation` | array | no | World [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees for the new actor (optional, default [0, 0, 0]). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_path: string, already_existed: bool, name: string }`

## `define_usd_prim`

*Destructive.*

Define a prim (specifier def) of type_name at prim_path on a registered USD stage, at its current edit target, defining missing ancestors as typeless prims. On an existing prim of another type it replaces the type, so leaving type_name out retypes it to Xform. The requested specifier is then authored at the edit target (specifier_set_ok); specifier reports it only when that write succeeded, and a failed write fails the call. An unknown specifier is refused before anything is authored. In memory only: save_usd_stage writes it. override_usd_prim authors an over instead; set_usd_prim_metadata with key "typeName" changes only the type.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath, e.g. /World/Cube |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under |
| `type_name` | string | no | USD type name (Xform, Mesh, Cube, Scope, Camera, DistantLight...). Default: Xform |
| `specifier` | string | no | "Def" \| "Over" \| "Class", case-insensitive; anything else is refused. Default: Def |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, type_name: string, specifier?: string, is_valid: bool, specifier_set_ok: bool, requested?: object }`

## `flatten_usd_stage`

*Destructive.*

Export a flattened copy of the stage to a .usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz file (the file writer is chosen by the extension).  Wraps UE::FUsdStage::Export(OutputPath, bAddSourceFileComment, FileFormatArguments) — does NOT alter the in-memory stage. When add_source_file_comment is true (default) the flattened file includes a comment header noting the source file (useful for provenance). The returned 'exported' field reports pxr::'s bool return — false means the file writer could not write the requested path (e.g. invalid extension, permission denied). Realistic gotcha: stage.Export() requires the stage NOT be in a restricted-edit state — under headless cov this is not an issue, but in-editor it can be during PIE.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under, OR an absolute file path to auto-open. |
| `output_path` | string | yes | Absolute path of the flattened file to write. The file extension picks the writer (.usda=text, .usdc=binary, .usdz=archive). |
| `add_source_file_comment` | boolean | no | Include the source-file comment header in the flattened file (default true). |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, resolution: string, output_path: string, exported: bool, add_source_file_comment: bool, errors: [string]? }`

## `get_usd_attribute_value`

*Read-only.*

Read the composed value of one attribute on a prim of a registered USD stage, at the time code in time, else at the default time (the static default, not a sample), possibly a schema fallback (has_value true, has_authored_value false). value is {type, value}: a scalar as a boolean, number or string; a pathExpression as its text; a vector, color or point as an array of numbers; a quaternion as [x, y, z, w], real part last; a matrix as an array of rows; an array attribute as a JSON array of those plus length and truncated, cut at 600 numbers or strings (fewer long strings). Another type, or no value, gives null with a note. A missing attribute is present=false; a missing stage or prim is an error. Read-only. Every attribute: list_usd_prim_attributes; sampled times: get_usd_attribute_time_samples; author a value: set_usd_attribute_value.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under by open_usd_stage (default the file basename) or create_usd_stage (default "Untitled"). |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim on that stage, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `attr_name` | string | yes | Attribute name to read, e.g. "size" |
| `time` | number | no | Optional USD time code to read at, e.g. 24; when omitted the default time is read (the static default value, not a sample) |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, attr_name: string, present: bool, has_value?: bool, has_authored_value?: bool, type?: string, type_name?: string, time?: number, value?: { type: string, value: any, length?: number, truncated?: bool, note?: string } | null, note?: string }`

## `get_usd_generated_assets`

*Read-only.*

Resolve the transient assets (UStaticMesh, USkeletalMesh, UMaterial, etc.) generated by the stage actor for a given prim path.  Wraps AUsdStageActor::GetGeneratedAssets(prim_path). Returns an empty assets array (count:0) when the prim has no generated assets — NOT an error. A prim may produce multiple assets (e.g. a skinned mesh produces USkeletalMesh + USkeleton + UPhysicsAsset).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_path` | string | yes | Full actor path (or short name) of the AUsdStageActor. |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Full prim path, e.g. "/root_prim/my_mesh". |

**Returns:** `{ actor_path: string, prim_path: string, assets: [string], count: int }`

## `get_usd_generated_component`

*Read-only.*

Resolve a transient USceneComponent generated by the stage actor for a given prim path.  Wraps AUsdStageActor::GetGeneratedComponent(prim_path). Returns present:false (NOT an error) when the path is invalid or the prim has no generated component — the LLM can pivot on this cleanly. When present, also returns component_class (the runtime UClass name).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_path` | string | yes | Full actor path (or short name) of the AUsdStageActor. |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Full prim path, e.g. "/root_prim/my_prim". |

**Returns:** `{ actor_path: string, prim_path: string, present: bool, component_path?: string, component_class?: string }`

## `get_usd_prim_info`

*Read-only.*

Read one prim of a registered USD stage: name, type_name, active, parent_path, direct children_count, applied_schemas, variant_sets and an is_a map for nine common types (Xform, Mesh, Cube, Scope, Camera, four lights). A missing prim returns is_valid=false with a note, not an error. Read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of the prim to read, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under by create_usd_stage or open_usd_stage; a stage already in the USD cache also matches by the end of its root layer identifier. |

**Returns:** `{ name: string, prim_path: string, type_name: string, active: bool, is_valid: bool, is_pseudo_root: bool, parent_path: string, children_count: number, applied_schemas: [string], variant_sets: [string], is_a: { Xform, Mesh, Cube, Scope, Camera, DistantLight, SphereLight, RectLight, MeshLight: bool } }, or { prim_path, is_valid: false, note } when the prim does not exist`

## `get_usd_prim_metadata`

*Read-only.*

Read the metadata of a prim on a registered USD stage as USD resolves it: one key (present plus value as {type, value}) or, with no key, all entries (authored and fallback) plus count; composition arcs such as references are read by key only, as their strongest opinion. Values read as get_usd_attribute_value reads them, an Sdf enum such as specifier as its number; a dictionary (customData, with the schema's fallback entries) as an object of {type, value} entries; a list op as {explicit} or {prepended, appended, deleted, ordered?, added?} arrays of item texts (numbers for an integer list op), apiSchemas, inactiveIds and other non-arc list ops composed into one explicit list; both with length and truncated. One reply holds about 30000 characters of values: past that, values are cut and further entries listed in omitted_keys. Above 100 entries only count and a note return. Read-only. Author with set_usd_prim_metadata; prim summary: get_usd_prim_info.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under by create_usd_stage or open_usd_stage; a stage already in the USD cache also matches by the end of its root layer identifier. |
| `key` | string | no | Metadata field to read, e.g. "documentation"; empty or omitted (default) returns all entries. |

**Returns:** `{ present: bool, key: string, value: { type: string, value: any, length?: number, truncated?: bool, note?: string }, metadata: object, count: number, truncated?: bool, omitted_keys?: [string], note?: string }`

*Read-only.*

Read live metadata from an AUsdStageActor.  Returns the root layer identifier + real path from the actor's currently-open UE::FUsdStage (via GetUsdStage()), the integer EUsdStageState (0=Closed, 1=Opened, 2=OpenedAndLoaded), the presence of a generated ULevelSequence (a non-null GetLevelSequence()), and the count of USceneComponents the actor has spawned (via GetComponents()). All read-only.

**Returns:** `{ actor_path: string, root_layer: string, real_path: string, stage_state: int, stage_state_name: string, has_level_sequence: bool, generated_component_count: int, has_isolated_stage: bool, errors: [string]? }`

## `get_usd_stage_info`

*Read-only.*

Read metadata about a USD stage: root layer identifier, real path, dirty flag, timecode range (start/end), frames-per-second, total prim count (recursive) and layer-stack depth (includes session layers when include_session_layers is true).  Resolves stage_name via the LLM-facing UEAgent::UsdRegistry::GStageNameCache first, then falls back to treating stage_name as a file path and auto-opening it (LoadAll, use cache). Returns 'resolution' as one of "cache_hit" / "auto_opened" so the caller knows which path served the stage.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under, OR an absolute file path to auto-open. |
| `include_session_layers` | boolean | no | Include session layers when computing the layer-stack depth (default true). |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, resolution: string, identifier: string, real_path: string, dirty: bool, start_time: number, end_time: number, frames_per_second: number, prim_count: int, layer_stack_count: int, has_start_time: bool, has_end_time: bool, has_fps: bool, errors: [string]? }`

## `isolate_usd_layer`

*Destructive.*

Enter isolated mode by replacing the actor's displayed stage with a new stage rooted at one of the sublayers of the current layer stack.  Wraps AUsdStageActor::IsolateLayer(Layer, b_load_usd_stage). The layer_index selects into Stage.GetLayerStack(true) — index 0 is the root layer, >0 are sublayers. When b_load_usd_stage is true (default) assets, actors and components are regenerated from the isolated stage; when false the isolation is structural only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_path` | string | yes | Full actor path (or short name) of the AUsdStageActor. |
| `layer_index` | number | no | Index into the actor's stage layer stack (default 0 = root layer). |
| `b_load_usd_stage` | boolean | no | Load assets/components from the isolated stage (default true). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_path: string, layer_index: int, isolated_layer: string, b_load_usd_stage: bool }`

## `list_usd_file_formats`

*Read-only.*

List the USD file format extensions the engine supports, with optional human-readable descriptions -- also the probe of whether the USDCore plugin loaded: native_present / supported_present false (a zero count) means it did not.  Always returns the native set ("usd"/"usda"/"usdc"/"usdz", UnrealUSDWrapper::GetNativeFileFormats) and the full supported set (native + third-party USD plugin extensions like "abc" from usdAbc, GetAllSupportedFileFormats). When include_descriptions is true, also calls AddUsdImportFileFormatDescriptions to populate the human-readable per-extension description strings (e.g. "usdc; Universal Scene Description binary files").

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_descriptions` | boolean | no | Also return the per-extension import description strings from UnrealUSDWrapper::AddUsdImportFileFormatDescriptions (optional, default false). |

**Returns:** `{ native_formats: [string], supported_formats: [string], native_count: int, supported_count: int, native_present: bool, supported_present: bool, descriptions: [{format: string, description: string}]? }`

| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim on that stage, e.g. "/World/Cube". |

## `list_usd_prims`

*Read-only.*

List the prims under one prim (default the pseudo root "/") on a registered USD stage, each with prim_path, type_name and active, plus count: its direct children, or with recursive=true its whole subtree in depth-first order. Only active, loaded, defined, non-abstract prims appear, and instance proxies are not traversed. Read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under by create_usd_stage or open_usd_stage; a stage already in the USD cache also matches by the end of its root layer identifier. |
| `prim_path_prefix` | string | no | SdfPath of the prim whose children are listed; it must exist. Default "/" (the pseudo root). |
| `recursive` | boolean | no | false (default) lists the direct children only; true lists every descendant, each parent before its children. |

**Returns:** `{ prims: [{ prim_path, type_name, active }], count: number }`

## `list_usd_stage_layers`

*Read-only.*

List the layer stack of a USD stage opened with open_usd_stage or create_usd_stage, read-only: each layer's index in the stack, identifier, real_path, is_muted, dirty and sublayer paths, plus count and any captured USD errors; with layer_index only that layer. An unregistered stage_name, a layer_index outside the stack or an invalid layer at it is an error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under via open_usd_stage or create_usd_stage. |
| `include_session_layers` | boolean | no | When true (default) the returned stack also includes the stage's session/auto-generated layers; pass false to get only the persistent root + sublayers. layer_index counts in this stack. |
| `layer_index` | number | no | Optional 0-based index into the layer stack (the root layer is 0); report only that layer |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, include_session_layers: bool, count: int, layers: [{ index: int, identifier: string, real_path: string, is_muted: bool, dirty: bool, sub_layer_paths: [string], sub_layer_count: int }], layer_index?: int, errors: [string]? }`

## `list_usd_stages`

*Read-only.*

Enumerate every stage currently in the UnrealUSDWrapper stage cache (shared across C++ + Python).  Returns one entry per cached stage with the root layer identifier, real path and dirty flag. It reads the engine's stage cache directly, so it also lists the stages opened outside these tools (Python USD scripts, the editor's USD importer). Each entry's 'stage_name' is the name the stage was opened under through these tools; it is empty for a stage they did not open.

No parameters.

**Returns:** `{ stages: [{stage_name: string, identifier: string, real_path: string, dirty: bool}], count: int }`

## `list_usd_variant_sets`

*Read-only.*

List every variant set authored on a prim with its variant names and the current selection for each set (the selections map may be empty when no selection is authored), or with variant_set_name only that set, reported also as variant_set_name, current_selection and variant_count. A variant_set_name the prim does not author is an error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | SdfPath of the prim to inspect |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Stage cache key |
| `variant_set_name` | string | no | Optional name of the one variant set to report |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, names: [string], selections: object, variants: object (set name -> [variant name]), count: int, variant_set_name?: string, current_selection?: string, variant_count?: int }`

## `mute_usd_layer`

*Destructive.*

Toggle mute state on a set of layers by their identifiers (mute + unmute are passed in the same call — pxr:: applies them atomically).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under. |
| `mute_paths` | array | no | Identifiers of layers to mute. Empty/missing is allowed (no-op on the mute side). |
| `unmute_paths` | array | no | Identifiers of layers to unmute. Empty/missing is allowed (no-op on the unmute side). |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, muted: [string], unmuted: [string], errors: [string]? }`

## `open_usd_stage`

*Destructive.*

Open an existing USD stage from a file path.  Wraps UnrealUSDWrapper::OpenStage with caching and force-reload controls. When use_stage_cache is true (default) and the file is already open in the UnrealUSDWrapper stage cache, the existing stage is returned. When force_reload is true, all local layers are forced-reloaded from disk (useful when the file was modified by another tool since the last open). The opened stage is added to the LLM-facing UEAgent::UsdRegistry::GStageNameCache under either the explicit stage_name or a derived one (basename without extension). The stage_id returned is the root layer's USD identifier — a stable string handle useful as a unique reference across follow-up commands.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file_path` | string | yes | Absolute path to the .usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz file (or a USD layer identifier). |
| `stage_name` | string | no | LLM-facing name to register the opened stage under. Defaults to the file basename without extension (optional). |
| `initial_load_set` | string | no | "LoadAll" (default; loads payloads) or "LoadNone" (faster; inspect without loading payloads). |
| `use_stage_cache` | boolean | no | Use UnrealUSDWrapper's stage cache (default true). When false the stage is re-read and not added to the cache. |
| `force_reload` | boolean | no | Force-reload all local layers from disk, bypassing the layer registry (default false). |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, stage_id: string, identifier: string, real_path: string, from_cache: bool, file_path: string, errors: [string]? }`

## `override_usd_prim`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Author an over (specifier over, no type) at prim_path on a registered USD stage, at its current edit target, with overs for missing ancestors, to add opinions to a prim without defining it. A prim that already exists there is returned untouched (already_existed true, no specifier reported, since nothing was authored); specifier Over comes back only for an over this call authored. is_valid=false means USD refused; a missing stage or a bad path is an error. In memory only: save_usd_stage writes it. define_usd_prim creates a typed def; set_usd_prim_specifier changes the specifier of an existing prim.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath to author the over at, e.g. "/World/Cube" |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under by create_usd_stage or open_usd_stage; a stage already in the USD cache also matches by the end of its root layer identifier. |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, is_valid: bool, already_existed: bool, specifier?: string }`

## `remove_usd_attribute`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Remove one attribute from a prim on a registered USD stage by deleting its scene description in the current edit target layer only, so opinions from other layers or references can keep it composed. Idempotent: an absent attribute gives present=false and removed=false, not an error, and a relationship of that name counts as absent. A stage not registered under stage_name or a missing prim is an error. In memory only: save_usd_stage writes it. To keep the attribute and drop its values use clear_usd_attribute.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under by open_usd_stage (default the file basename) or create_usd_stage (default "Untitled"). |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim on that stage, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `attr_name` | string | yes | Name of the attribute to remove, e.g. "size" |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, attr_name: string, removed: bool, present: bool }`

## `remove_usd_prim`

*Destructive.*

Remove a prim and its subtree from the current edit target layer of a registered USD stage, returning removed. Opinions in other layers or references can keep it composed; set_usd_prim_metadata with key "active" and value false is the reversible way to hide a prim. Not saved to disk.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of the prim to remove, e.g. "/World/Cube"; its descendants go with it. |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under by create_usd_stage or open_usd_stage; a stage already in the USD cache also matches by the end of its root layer identifier. |

**Returns:** `{ removed: bool, prim_path: string }`

## `remove_usd_prim_schema`

*Destructive.*

Remove an applied API schema (e.g. "MaterialBindingAPI") from an existing prim of a registered USD stage, on the current edit target. A schema the prim does not have returns removed=false and was_applied=false instead of an error. Not saved to disk; inverse of apply_usd_prim_schema.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `schema_name` | string | yes | Schema identifier as listed in applied_schemas by get_usd_prim_info, e.g. "MaterialBindingAPI". |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under by create_usd_stage or open_usd_stage; a stage already in the USD cache also matches by the end of its root layer identifier. |

**Returns:** `{ removed: bool, schema_name: string }`

## `remove_usd_sublayer`

*Destructive.*

Remove a sublayer by index from the stage's root layer's composition stack.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under. |
| `sublayer_index` | number | yes | 0-based index into GetSubLayerPaths() of the root layer. |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, sublayer_index: int, removed: bool, new_count: int, errors: [string]? }`

## `remove_usd_variant`

*Destructive.*

Delete one variant from a variant set of a prim of a cached USD stage: on every spec of the prim in the stage's local layer stack the variant spec goes (with the opinions authored inside it), and a selection of that variant is cleared. Inverse of add_usd_variant. Opinions on a layer outside the local stack (a reference or payload) are left as they are and counted in specs_skipped. A set the prim does not have is an error; a variant the set does not have is an honest no-op (removed=false). Irreversible, like every USD composition edit here (no undo); save with save_usd_stage. Read: list_usd_variant_sets; the whole set: remove_usd_variant_set.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | SdfPath of the prim that authors the variant set |
| `variant_set_name` | string | yes | Variant set that holds the variant |
| `variant_name` | string | yes | Name of the variant to delete |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Stage cache key |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, variant_set_name: string, variant_name: string, removed: bool, specs_edited: int, specs_skipped: int, still_present: bool, variant_names: [string] }`

## `remove_usd_variant_set`

*Destructive.*

Delete a variant set from a prim of a cached USD stage, as the variant set editor does: on every spec of the prim in the stage's local layer stack (root, sublayers, session layer) the variant set with all its variants goes, with its name in the variant set list and its selection. Inverse of add_usd_variant_set; clear_usd_variant_selection only clears the selection. Opinions authored on a layer outside the local stack (one brought in by a reference or payload) are left as they are and counted in specs_skipped, so the set can still show (still_present). A prim that does not author the set is an honest no-op (removed=false); a missing stage or prim is an error. Irreversible, like every USD composition edit here (no undo); save with save_usd_stage. Read: list_usd_variant_sets.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | SdfPath of the prim that authors the variant set |
| `variant_set_name` | string | yes | Name of the variant set to delete |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Stage cache key |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, variant_set_name: string, removed: bool, specs_edited: int, specs_skipped: int, still_present: bool }`

## `save_usd_stage`

*Destructive.*

Save a USD stage's root layer to disk.  Wraps UE::FSdfLayer::Save(force) on the resolved stage's root layer. When force is false (default) and the root layer is clean, Save is a no-op and returns false — this is the USD-spec behavior and is reported honestly via 'saved:false' rather than as an error. Use force=true to re-write a clean layer (rare — typically only when a downstream tool requires a specific mtime).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under, OR an absolute file path to auto-open. |
| `force` | boolean | no | Force-re-save even when the layer is clean (default false). |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, resolution: string, saved: bool, dirty: bool, force: bool, real_path: string, errors: [string]? }`

## `set_usd_attribute_value`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Author one attribute value on a prim of a registered USD stage, at the current edit target: a time sample at time, else the default; a missing attribute is created with type_name. The JSON value converts to the declared type: bool takes a boolean; integer types a whole number in range; half, float, double and timecode a number; string, token and asset a string; pathExpression the text of the expression; vectors, colors, points and texCoords an array of numbers; a quaternion [x, y, z, w]; a matrix an array of rows; an array type a JSON array of those. Another shape or range, a text that does not parse as a path expression (the error gives USD's parse message), opaque or group (valueless by design) or a new attribute without type_name fails, writing nothing. If USD refuses it, success is false and a created attribute is removed. In memory: save_usd_stage writes it; get_usd_attribute_value reads it back.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under by open_usd_stage (default the file basename) or create_usd_stage (default "Untitled"). |
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim on that stage, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `attr_name` | string | yes | Attribute name to set, e.g. "size" |
| `type_name` | string | no | USD type name of the attribute to create when it does not exist yet, e.g. "float" or "token"; required in that case, and ignored (with a note when it differs) for an existing attribute, whose declared type decides. |
| `value` | any | no | The value: a JSON scalar, e.g. 2.5, "inherited" or true, a JSON array, e.g. [1, 0.5, 0] for a color3f or [[0, 0, 1]] for a float3[], or an object {"value": &lt;value>} whose "type" key, if any, is not used; it is converted to the declared type of the attribute. On UE 5.7 a pathExpression value cannot be written (needs UE 5.8); reading one works. |
| `time` | number | no | Optional USD time code to author a time sample at, e.g. 24; when omitted the default value is authored |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, attr_name: string, set: bool, type_name: string, type: string, created: bool, time?: number, note?: string }`

## `set_usd_edit_target`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Point the stage's edit target at a specific layer in the stack (mutations after this call land on the chosen layer, not the root).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under. |
| `layer_index` | number | no | 0-based index into GetLayerStack(true) of the new edit target. Defaults to 0 (the root layer). |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, layer_index: int, edit_target: string, edit_target_real_path: string, errors: [string]? }`

## `set_usd_prim_metadata`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Author one metadata field (e.g. "comment", "kind", "customData", "apiSchemas", or the well-known "active" (bool; false deactivates the prim and its subtree, the reversible alternative to remove_usd_prim), "instanceable" (bool, USD native instancing), "displayName" (string UI label; the prim name does not change) and "typeName" (token, written as given, not checked against the schema registry)) on an existing prim of a registered USD stage, at the current edit target. The value is converted to the field's type, read from its resolved value or, for a standard field resolving to nothing (kind, comment, hidden, customData, apiSchemas, references...), the type Sdf registers: scalars, vectors, matrices and arrays as set_usd_attribute_value converts them; a dictionary from an object of entries; a list op from {explicit} or {prepended, appended, deleted, ordered, added} arrays of item texts, or of whole numbers for an integer list op such as inactiveIds. Any other field takes the type value names, else its JSON type. A value that does not fit writes nothing; if USD refuses the write, success is false with set=false and its errors. In memory: save_usd_stage writes it; get_usd_prim_metadata reads it back as USD resolves it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `key` | string | yes | Registered USD prim metadata field, e.g. "comment", "kind", "customData" or "apiSchemas"; a key USD does not register as prim metadata fails with success false and set=false. |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under by create_usd_stage or open_usd_stage; a stage already in the USD cache also matches by the end of its root layer identifier. |
| `value` | any | no | The value itself (a scalar, an array, or an object of dictionary entries) or {type?, value}. It is converted to the field's type when that is known, and type is then not used; else type, or the JSON type, decides (bool, number as double, string, object as dictionary). A list op is {"explicit": [...]} or {"prepended": [...], "appended", "deleted", "ordered", "added"}, a reference item "@a.usda@&lt;/Prim>", an integer list op item a whole number. On UE 5.7 an integer list op (int, uint, int64 or uint64) cannot be written (needs UE 5.8); reading one works. |

**Returns:** `{ set: bool, prim_path: string, key: string, value: object, declared_type?: string, errors?: [string] }`

## `set_usd_prim_specifier`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Change the specifier ("Def", "Over" or "Class") of an existing prim on a registered USD stage, at the current edit target. An unknown specifier is refused before anything is authored. specifier reports the one written, only when the write succeeded (set); a failed write fails the call. Not saved to disk.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | Absolute SdfPath of an existing prim, e.g. "/World/Cube". |
| `specifier` | string | yes | "Def", "Over" or "Class", case-insensitive; anything else is refused. |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Name the stage was registered under by create_usd_stage or open_usd_stage; a stage already in the USD cache also matches by the end of its root layer identifier. |

**Returns:** `{ set: bool, specifier?: string, requested?: object }`

## `set_usd_stage_actor_root_layer`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Assign a USD file as the actor's root layer and transition the stage state.  Wraps AUsdStageActor::SetRootLayer(path) followed by AUsdStageActor::SetStageState(state). SetStageState(OpenedAndLoaded) triggers level-sequence regeneration — this can take a noticeable amount of time on large stages, so the cov harness may observe a transient 'rebuilding' state via follow-up get_usd_stage_actor_info calls. The tool does NOT verify the file exists on disk — SetRootLayer stores the path; the actual load happens during SetStageState(OpenedAndLoaded). When root_layer_path is empty, the existing root layer is preserved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_path` | string | yes | Full actor path (or short name) of the AUsdStageActor. |
| `root_layer_path` | string | yes | Absolute file path of the USD file (.usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz). |
| `stage_state` | string | no | "OpenedAndLoaded" (default), "Opened", or "Closed". |

**Returns:** `{ actor_path: string, root_layer_path: string, stage_state: string }`

## `set_usd_stage_time_range`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set a USD stage's start/end time codes and optionally its frames-per-second, then save the root layer (idempotent — no-op when !dirty).  Both start_time and end_time are required and are written via UE::FUsdStage::SetStartTimeCode / SetEndTimeCode (which write to the stage's root layer metadata). When frames_per_second > 0, also calls SetFramesPerSecond. The Save() at the end is force=false so a layer that wasn't actually mutated by the Set* calls will not produce an unnecessary write.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_name` | string | yes | Name the stage was registered under, OR an absolute file path to auto-open. |
| `start_time` | number | yes | New start time code (e.g. 0.0). |
| `end_time` | number | yes | New end time code (e.g. 24.0). |
| `frames_per_second` | number | no | Optional frames-per-second override; values &lt;= 0 are ignored (use get_usd_stage_info / set_usd_stage_time_range to leave fps untouched). |

**Returns:** `{ stage_name: string, resolution: string, start_time: number, end_time: number, frames_per_second: number, applied: bool, saved: bool, dirty: bool, errors: [string]? }`

## `set_usd_variant_selection`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the active variant for a variant set; HasVariantSet guard prevents the FUsdVariantSet from going invalid when the set is missing

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prim_path` | string | yes | SdfPath of the prim that authors the variant set |
| `variant_set_name` | string | yes | Variant set to select a variant from |
| `variant_name` | string | yes | Variant to activate (must already be present — use add_usd_variant first) |
| `stage_name` | string | no | Stage cache key |

**Returns:** `{ prim_path: string, variant_set_name: string, variant_name: string, set: bool }`
